sources.title: DAMO Academy Unveils COCA: AI Model for Colorectal Cancer Detection
sources.snippet: The advanced AI model can detect colorectal cancer with high accuracy and improved early detection rates. It is part of Alibaba DAMO Academy's broader effort to build AI-powered screening tools for multiple cancers using existing CT imaging data.
